podcast.name: Week in Review

turns.text: Hi there, and welcome to the show. It's Sunday, November 8th. I'm Natasha, and this is Week in Review from MMH Daily.
And I’m William, your co-host. Let’s get into it.

Coming up: Solving the problem of medical equipment prices in public hospitals: What determines the hospital's purchase price?; Vietnam sets key economic targets for 2027; Top leader calls for a modern, safe, efficient coal industry, upholding spirit of "discipline and unity".
Let’s start with health.
Solving the problem of medical equipment prices in public hospitals: What determines the hospital's purchase price?.

Medical equipment prices between hospitals may vary due to procurement scale, configuration, time of purchase and payment conditions. Private hospitals can flexibly negotiate with suppliers, while public hospitals must carry out the contractor selection process according to regulations.
On the policy front.
Another one to watch: Complete regulations on quality management of traditional medicines, traditional medicines, and medicinal herbs.

The amendments and supplements to Circular No. 32/2025/TT-BYT as well as other Circulars in the field of traditional medicine are steps to concretize the task of perfecting institutions and policies towards the goal of building the Law on Traditional Medicine, expected to be submitted to the National Assembly by the end of 2028.
Draft Food Safety Law: Resolving the 'painful' problem with the group of dietary supplements.
The Ministry of Health is urgently completing the Draft Food Safety Law to submit it to the 16th National Assembly for consideration on November 11.
Another one to watch: Respect for the Constitution and the law – The driving force for national development.

On the occasion of Vietnam Law Day, Health and Life Newspaper respectfully introduces the article "Respect for the Constitution and the law, the driving force for national development" by General Secretary and President To Lam.
Increase social assistance standards for poor households in 2026.

The social assistance standard has been adjusted to increase to 540,000 dong/month according to Decree 335/2026/ND-CP, contributing to improving the level of support for some groups of poor people in difficult circumstances in 2026.
There’s also this: Ministry of Health discusses draft revised Food Safety Law with international representatives and foreign embassies.

The drafting committee for the revised Food Safety Law held a working session with the Delegation of the European Union and the embassies of 12 countries to discuss recommendations concerning the draft legislation on the afternoon of November 6.
Now, business and the economy.
Vietnam sets key economic targets for 2027.

General Secretary of the Communist Party of Vietnam Central Committee and State President To Lam, on behalf of the Party Central Committee, signed Conclusion No. 106-KL/TW, dated October 15, 2026, of the fourth meeting of the 14th Party Central Committee on socio-economic development, state budget implementation in 2026 and plans for 2027.
There’s also this: Factors putting pressure on interest rates in 2027.

Experts expect interest rates in major currencies to cool down in 2027, which will partly reduce pressure on domestic interest rates. However, expanding liquidity support tools is facing challenges; Therefore, it is necessary to accelerate the disbursement of stagnant money at the Treasury, combined with expanding other medium and long-term capital channels to support monetary policy management...
Accelerate disbursement of public investment capital.

By the end of October 2026, many localities will achieve high disbursement rates of public investment capital, promoting economic growth. However, the amount of capital that needs to be disbursed in the last two months of the year is still large, requiring localities to continue to find solutions to remove problems and increase the responsibility of investors and leaders.
And this one: Vietnam, Finland move to strengthen political trust, expand cooperation.

Politburo Member and Head of the Party Central Committee’s Commission for Publicity Trinh Van suggested that Finland further promote its role as a bridge between Vietnam and the European Union, while Vietnam could serve as a bridge between Finland and the Association of Southeast Asian Nations.
Upcoming discussion "Reducing interest rates: Room and solutions to support double-digit growth".
m. on November 9, 2026, Vietnam Economic Magazine/VnEconomy organized a discussion "Reducing interest rates: Room and solutions to support double-digit growth".
In politics.
Top leader calls for a modern, safe, efficient coal industry, upholding spirit of "discipline and unity".

Upholding the tradition of "Discipline and Unity", General Secretary of the Communist Party of Vietnam Central Committee and President To Lam called for building a modern workforce, improving workers’ skills, promoting technological innovation and ensuring better living conditions.
Another one to watch: General Secretary and President To Lam and his wife set out for an official visit to Japan.
On November 8, General Secretary and President To Lam, his wife Ngo Phuong Ly and a high-ranking Vietnamese delegation left the capital Hanoi for an official visit to Japan from November 8-11.
Permanent Deputy Prime Minister Pham Gia Tuc inspected the progress of the Quy Nhon - Pleiku expressway.

On the morning of November 7, during the working program in Gia Lai province, Politburo member and Permanent Deputy Prime Minister Pham Gia Tuc inspected the construction progress of the Quy Nhon - Pleiku Expressway Project.
Closer to home, on the society pages.
Hanoi invested nearly 225 billion dong to improve 7 roads, reducing traffic congestion.

Hanoi invested nearly 225 billion dong to renovate and expand 7 key roads in the west and city center in the period 2025-2027. The project focuses on upgrading infrastructure, adjusting traffic organization, expanding lanes, contributing to reducing congestion and improving circulation capacity in the capital.
There’s also this: Let the law 'take root' in highland life.

Bringing the law to ethnic minority and mountainous areas means giving people here the knowledge to protect themselves, giving the community tools to solve problems and creating a foundation for grassroots authorities to manage society with clear and transparent rules.
Vietnam Law Day: Bringing the spirit of rule of law into life.

After 13 years of implementation, Vietnam Law Day contributes to raising awareness and sense of law observance in society. In the new period, the requirement is to bring the spirit of respect for the Constitution and laws into the behavioral and cultural standards of each person, agency and organization.
That wraps it up for today. Every story is in today’s paper, with summaries in Vietnamese and English. I'm William. Talk to you tomorrow.
And I'm Natasha. Goodbye for now.

Dự án tập trung nâng cấp hạ tầng, điều chỉnh tổ chức giao thông, mở rộng làn xe, góp phần giảm ùn tắc và nâng cao năng lực lưu thông trên địa bàn Thủ đô. 0b0a16d77fbc.s_en: Hanoi invested nearly 225 billion VND to renovate and expand 7 key roads in the west and city center in the period 2025-2027. The project focuses on upgrading infrastructure, adjusting traffic organization, expanding lanes, contributing to reducing congestion and improving circulation capacity in the capital. 5d4c49263e1f.s_en: Bringing the law to ethnic minority and mountainous areas means giving people here the knowledge to protect themselves, giving the community tools to solve problems and creating a foundation for grassroots authorities to manage society with clear and transparent rules.

b3f53240065b.t: Ngày Pháp luật Việt Nam: Đưa tinh thần thượng tôn pháp luật vào đời sống
b3f53240065b.sum: Sau 13 năm triển khai, Ngày Pháp luật Việt Nam góp phần nâng cao nhận thức, ý thức chấp hành pháp luật trong xã hội. Trong giai đoạn mới, yêu cầu đặt ra là đưa tinh thần thượng tôn Hiến pháp, pháp luật trở thành chuẩn mực ứng xử và văn hóa của mỗi người dân, cơ quan, tổ chức.
b3f53240065b.h_en: Vietnam Law Day: Bringing the spirit of rule of law into life
b3f53240065b.s_en: After 13 years of implementation, Vietnam Law Day contributes to raising awareness and sense of law observance in society. In the new period, the requirement is to bring the spirit of respect for the Constitution and laws into the behavioral and cultural standards of each person, agency and organization.

da8955b0a646.s_en: A blow to the neck while playing caused a boy over 5 years old to suffer a broken trachea, severe respiratory failure, widespread air spread under the skin and compression of important organs. Doctors at the National Children's Hospital had to mobilize many specialties to urgently resuscitate and perform a 3-hour surgery to restore the trachea and save the patient's life.
